ai_summary: Aegis Logistics Limited has completed an intra-group slump sale of its newly commissioned Ammonia storage terminal at Pipavav Port to its step-down subsidiary, Aegis Terminal (Pipavav) Limited, for INR 525 Crores. This cash transaction, stated as an arm's length related party deal, aims to consolidate terminalling services, enhance operational synergies, and establish a new growth platform within the Group. While the rapid transfer of a recently commissioned asset between related entities always warrants scrutiny regarding valuation, the stated rationale aligns with strategic group consolidation.
